error.account_not_confirmed: This account hasn't been confirmed yet. Open the Fluidra Pool app, finish the email verification Fluidra sent you, then try again.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check your email and password. If your account is registered outside the EMEA region (Europe), it is not currently supported.
error.invalid_mfa_code: Invalid or expired verification code. Please try again.
error.no_pools: No pools found. Make sure your equipment is configured in the Fluidra Pool app
error.password_reset_required: Fluidra requires a password reset for this account. Reset it in the Fluidra Pool app or on the Fluidra website, then sign in here with the new password.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many sign-in attempts. Fluidra has temporarily blocked this account — wait a few minutes before trying again.

schedule_vs_pump_unsupported.message: Cannot write schedules to {device_id}: this device is configured with a variable-speed pump, whose schedule slots also carry a target pump speed that this service cannot set. Writing an incomplete slot makes the Fluidra app unable to load the device. Use the Fluidra app for variable-speed pump schedules.

schedule_write_not_stored.message: Cannot write schedules to {device_id}: this device stores something different from what is sent — verified on hardware, the times and days both come back altered, and the device acts on the altered schedule. Writing would run your equipment at hours you did not choose. Use the Fluidra app for schedules on this device until this is resolved (issue #174).
